title: Custom styles odp 001
notes: real ODP named styles: styles.xml office:styles holds paragraph styles "GP Body" (style:family="paragraph", fo:font-size 18pt) and "GP Head" (family paragraph, style:parent-style-name="GP Body", bold 28pt — a one-level parent chain), plus a CHARACTER-family style GP Char (fo:font-style italic). The presentation:body frame applies them from content.xml: two GP Body paragraphs (one carrying a GP Char text:span) and one GP Head paragraph, all via text:p text:style-name (named, not automatic, styles); the deck title frame stays on the named presentation style dp1. Honest caveat: style rendering (inheritance, span italics) is LibreOffice policy and LO was not run here. None of the five normative ODF counters match style elements, so the only nonzero counter is draw:frame=2; reference text is every visible paragraph string (style names themselves are not visible text).
